subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if so should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver` in `openclaw.json`?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally make delivery an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
options.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests, while keeping explicit CLI flags as the highest-precedence override.

options.title: Keep launch-only delivery
options.body: Leave delivery as an explicit per-session flag and document or close this request as an intentional product decision.

options.title: Use a TUI preference instead
options.body: Reject a global config key and design a TUI-owned persisted preference or settings flow if maintainers want per-surface persistence.

recommendation.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
recommendation.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests, while keeping explicit CLI flags as the highest-precedence override.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a config/default product decision for the TUI surface, and steipete has the strongest history signal for the original TUI implementation.
